title: Week of Oct 5 - Oct 11
subtitle: Block 4, build week 2 of 3. Same shape as last week, which you liked, bent around the trip: barbell work Monday, Wednesday and Thursday morning, then you fly Thursday evening and Friday through Sunday is running, calisthenics and rocks in California. 23 miles with the long run at 7.
goals: The week in one line: Mon lower, Tue threshold, Wed upper, Thu the Friday deadlift session moved up a day before the flight, then Fri easy 4 plus upper calisthenics and rocks, Sat long run 7 plus the pull-up day, Sun jog plus rock legs and yoga. Nothing from the barbell week is dropped, Thursday's easy run and Friday's lift just trade places.

Wednesday is reordered so the lats can't get cut again. Pull-ups and the neutral-grip pulldown now come straight after bench, and the cable row folds into the pushdown and curl as a tri-set, which saves about 8 minutes. If time runs short, the tri-set drops to two rounds and the lats stay whole.

Bench, road to 225: last Wednesday 205 went up fast once and the second rep wasn't there, so the 205x2 gate didn't clear. This week is two clean singles at 205 with 2x4 at 175 behind them, and 215 waits a week. That puts the 225 attempt on Oct 21 instead of Oct 14, which lands in the deload week when you'll be fresh. Thursday's paused bench is 3x4 at 155, light on purpose the day after the singles. Safety arms every heavy set.

Lower body steps are small because you're coming in tired: pause squat 175 → 180x5, hip thrust 230 → 235, split squats hold at 35s since they were very hard, back extensions at 35. Leg curl and calf targets are reset to what you actually used (90 and 60). Deficit deadlift repeats 255x4, the aim is the same weight feeling like 2 in reserve instead of near failure.

Running, 23 miles: Mon 1.5, Tue 5.5 (threshold 4x6 min), Wed 1.5, Thu 1, Fri 4, Sat 7, Sun 2.5. The block had 25 here. You ran about 20 last week with Saturday missed, Sunday night felt rough, and there's a cross-country flight in the middle, so 23 keeps the jump sensible and 27 is still reachable next week. Tuesday has a go or no-go check built in: if the warm-up reads high or the legs feel like Sunday, it becomes 5 easy.

Easy means 150 or under. Last week's finishing jogs read 163 and 160 and the easy 6 was 152, so the easy days are still running a bit hot. In California, heat and hills push it further, so slow down or walk the climbs and keep the cap.

Rocks: find two on Friday, one you can press overhead about 8 times and one clearly heavier. Friday is press and row, Sunday is goblet squats, single-leg RDLs and bear-hug carries. Guess the weights and log them so the graph has something. Lift every rock off the ground with a flat back and legs, the low back is still a watch item after the deficit pulls.

Saturday needs a bar for the pull-up max: a playground, a park fitness station or a solid branch. If there isn't one, rock rows stand in and the max waits a week. Volume, so the graph doesn't surprise you: about 53,000 lb on the barbell days plus roughly 5,000 from Saturday's pull-ups, against 64,000 planned last week. The gap is three days of bodyweight work that the app counts as zero, plus one fewer paused bench set.

Weight and food: deficit stays at 400. Travel days are where logging falls apart, so log full days or mark the day as unlogged, and don't read anything into the scale until Tuesday or Wednesday after you're home.
review: Build week 1 of Block 4. Monday: pause squat 175x5 as planned, hip thrusts 180 then 230 for three, split squats at 35s ('very hard'), and the leg curl target of 120 was 'way out of my range', you used 80 to 90. Wednesday: bench ramped 155, 175, 195, then 205 went up once and the second rep wasn't there, back-offs at 180 and 175, seated DB press 45s for all four, pull-ups 3x8, and the lat pulldowns got squeezed out when time ran short. The two midweek runs were both 6 miles, one easy at 152 and the threshold day at 163 average, against 5 and 4 planned. Friday: deficit deadlift 255x4 ('a new sort of strain, a bit close to failure'), paused bench 165 then 155 for three, rows at 65s. Saturday was the class retreat and Zach Bryan, so the long run and calisthenics didn't happen. Sunday evening 4.4 miles that felt rough. About 20 of 22 miles and 71 of 89 planned sets.

days.name: Lower · Pause Squat 180 + Hip Thrust
warmup: 3 min on rower, stairmaster or erg, easy pace
Cat-cow + slow bodyweight good mornings, 10 reps (back care)
Bodyweight squats with a 2s pause at the bottom, 1x8
Empty-bar pause squats, 1x5, find and own the bottom position

items.note: Same lift as last week, one small step. 95 warm-up, then 135x5, 155x5, 170x5 → 180x5 as the top set at about 2 in reserve. You hit 175x5 clean last Monday. You're coming in tired off the weekend, so if 170 already feels like a top set, stop there and repeat 175. 3 min rest before the top set.
items.focus: Sit into the hole, knees shoved out, count two with tension, then drive straight up. No bounce, no relaxing at the bottom.

items.note: 205x8 to open, then 235x8 for three. You did 180 then 230 for three last week, so this is 5 more on the working sets. Pad on the bar, 1s squeeze at the top.
items.focus: Chin tucked, ribs down, shins vertical at the top, glutes do the lifting, not the low back.

items.note: 35s again, logged as the pair total (70). You said these were very hard last week, so the weight holds and the goal is the same three sets feeling a rep easier. Drop to 30s if the first set is a grind. Weaker leg first.
items.focus: Front shin close to vertical, torso slightly forward, drive through the front heel.

items.note: 35 plate at the chest. You did 25 twice and 45 once last week, so 35 is the middle. Slow and controlled, no hyperextending at the top.
items.focus: Hinge at the hips, flat back, glutes finish the rep.

items.note: Three rounds at 60 / 90, reset to what you actually used last week. The 120s came from the old gym's machines, ignore them.
items.focus: Full stretch on the calves, don't let the leg curl stack drop.
Knees and chest meet in the middle, lower slowly.
items.note: Core circuit, 6 sets, floor only: tuck-up → side plank → flutter kicks, twice through, about 20s between moves.

items.focus: Stacked hips, straight line from ear to ankle.
Small and quick, low back stays down.

run.detail: Flush after the squats. Short and truly easy, tomorrow is threshold and yesterday's run felt rough.

hr.note: Post-lift HR runs hot early (163 and 160 on last week's jogs). Cue effort, and slow down if it is still over 155 after the first half mile.

days.name: Threshold · 4x6 min
warmup: 3x20s strides at the end of the warm-up, full walk-back

run.title: Threshold 4x6 min, 5.5 mi total
run.detail: 1.25 easy with the strides → 4 x 6 min at threshold with 2 min easy jog between → about 0.75 easy to finish. One minute longer per rep than last week, same effort: short phrases, not sentences, around 7:05 to 7:20 pace. Go or no-go check first, since Sunday night felt rough and Saturday was a late one: if the warm-up mile at easy effort reads over 155, or the legs feel like they did Sunday, run 5 easy at 150 or under and skip the reps. Nothing is lost by that this week.

hr.zone: Zone 4 on the reps (170-178), Zone 1-2 everywhere else
hr.main: reps at 170-178; if HR is over 180 by the 4th minute of a rep, ease the pace
hr.note: Four even reps with the last one the same as the first. Hold the HR band and let the pace be whatever it gives you.

days.name: Upper · Bench 205 Singles + Lats First
warmup: 3 min on rower, stairmaster or erg, easy pace
Set the safety arms at chest height BEFORE the first bench set

items.note: Bench 225 track. 135 warm-up, then 155x3, 175x2, 190x1 → 205x1, rest 3 min, 205x1 again (the app counts every set as 1 rep, that's fine). Last week the first rep at 205 came up fast and the second wasn't there, so this week is two clean singles at 205 instead of 215. Safety arms at chest height, no grinding. If both singles are fast, write that in the journal.

items.note: Two sets of 4 at 175, where your second back-off set landed last week.
items.focus: Same setup as the singles, crisp and fast.

items.note: MOVED UP. The lat work now comes straight after bench so it can't get squeezed out at the end like last week. Volume day: 3 sets of 8, submax, around 4 in reserve. Bodyweight in the weight field. Saturday is the max.
items.focus: Full hang, chest to the bar, controlled down.

items.note: Also moved up, second in the lat block. This is the piece that got cut last Wednesday. Start at 100 and calibrate the last set to about 2 in reserve, then log what you used.
items.focus: Lead with the elbows, chest up to the handle, no leaning back.

items.note: 45s, 45s, then 50s for the last two if the 45s still have 3 in reserve. You did 45s for all four last week. Log the PAIR total (90, 100).
items.focus: Ribs down against the pad, press up and slightly in, full lockout, control the way down.

items.note: The row folds into the arm pair to save about 8 minutes: row, pushdown, curl back to back, 60s, three rounds. If the clock runs out today, this is the block that gets shortened to two rounds, not the lats. Log the row weight this time, last week's went in blank.

Reach long, lower under control, don't slam down.

Slow and square, hips level, 2s pause each rep.

days.name: California · Easy 4 + Upper Calisthenics and Rocks
warmup: Find two rocks: one you can press overhead about 8 times (a guess of 35 to 50 lb), one clearly heavier for rows and carries

items.note: 25, 20, 20, 15, all two or three short of failure. Feet up on a bench or rock for the last two sets if flat ones are easy. Log the reps.
items.focus: Straight line, chest to fist height, full lockout.

items.note: Clean the lighter rock to your chest, press it overhead, standing. Three sets of 8 at about 2 in reserve. Put your best guess of the rock's weight in the weight field so the volume graph gets something. Clear ground around you, and drop it away from your feet if a rep goes wrong.
items.focus: Glutes and ribs locked, press straight up, head through at the top.

items.note: The heavier rock, both hands, hinge to about 45 degrees and row it to the belly. Four sets of 10 with a 1s squeeze. This is the weekend's horizontal pull, so use a rock that makes rep 10 honest. Guess the weight and log it.
items.focus: Flat back, hips still, pull the elbows back, no jerking it off the ground.

items.note: Three rounds. Dips off a bench, chair or low wall, feet out straight.
items.focus: Hips high on the pike, head between the hands. Shoulders down and back on the dips.
Slow and rotational, shoulder toward the knee.
items.note: Core circuit, 6 sets, floor only: bicycle crunch → plank shoulder taps → hollow hold, twice through.

items.focus: Hips dead still, feet wide if you need them.
Low back pressed down, ribs in, arms and legs long.

run.title: Easy Run, 4 mi
run.detail: Thursday's easy run, moved to the first morning in California. Four easy miles by heart rate. You'll be stiff from the flight and a few hours off on the clock, so the first mile is a shakeout, not a pace. Run first, then the strength.

Reach long, lower under control, don't slam down.
items.note: Core circuit, 6 sets, floor only: V-up → side plank → dead bug, twice through.

run.title: Long Run, 7 mi
run.detail: Seven easy miles, the long run for the week and the first Saturday one since the retreat took last week's. All Zone 2, no progression, no fast finish. Carry water, California sun is not Cambridge in October. Run first, then the calisthenics.

hr.cool: walk in, then to the bar
hr.note: If HR drifts past 150 in the last two miles at the same effort, slow down rather than push. If it is properly hot, cap it at 6 and call it done.

days.name: Easy Jog + Rock Legs + Yoga

items.note: Heaviest rock you can pick up with a flat back. Hug it high on the chest and walk about 40 yards, set it down under control, rest 60s. Three trips. This is the one real strength piece of the day.

run.title: Easy Jog + 6x20s Strides, 2.5 mi
run.detail: Two and a half easy to land the week at 23, with 6 x 20s relaxed strides in the back half. Then the rocks, then 15 minutes of yoga, hips and hamstrings first. If you're flying home today, do the jog and the yoga and leave the rocks. Waist measurement when you're back at your own tape.
